feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Baseline plasma C1q and C3 as potential biomarkers for lecanemab efficacy and ARIA risk in early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 基线血浆C1q和C3可预测早期阿尔茨海默病中lecanemab的疗效与ARIA风险。

drug.title: In brief: Subcutaneous lecanemab (Leqembi Iqlik) for initial treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
drug.journal: The Medical letter on drugs and therapeu
drug.zh: 皮下注射仑卡奈单抗可作为阿尔茨海默病起始治疗，疗效与静脉给药相当。

drug.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白治疗需警惕脑淀粉样血管病等脑血管共病，试验筛选偏倚限制其真实世界适用性。

drug.title: Conformational modulation and inhibition of lysozyme amyloid fibrillation by lanthanum-doped red carbon dots: a multispectroscopic, morphological, and molecular simulation study.
drug.journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular a
drug.zh: 镧掺杂红碳点通过氢键和范德华力结合溶菌酶非催化表面口袋，抑制其淀粉样纤维化。

drug.title: From public preferences to clinical tasks in anti-amyloid therapy for Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 日本受访者对抗淀粉样蛋白治疗的最小可接受获益高于实际疗效，提示需将期望-疗效差距转化为具体临床任务。

drug.title: Clinical immunology lessons from failed α-Synuclein and Tau immunotherapies: A roadmap for combination strategies in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: α-突触核蛋白与tau免疫疗法虽屡遭失败，但其表位选择、生物标志物分层、混合病理及神经炎症四大教训为阿尔茨海默病联合免疫策略指明方向。

drug.title: Beyond Amyloid: Systemic and Brain Frailty as Determinants of Response to Anti-Amyloid Therapy in Alzheimer's Disease-A Conceptual Review.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样治疗获益与风险取决于脑和全身衰弱，而非仅淀粉样蛋白负荷。

drug.title: Exosome-Based Therapeutics in Alzheimer's Disease: Translational Perspectives Beyond Conventional Therapies.
drug.zh: 外泌体凭借天然跨血脑屏障和多通路载药能力，有望突破现有阿尔茨海默病疗法局限。

mech.title: Abortive transcripts in exosomes - A potential biomarker for Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 外泌体中8核苷酸流产转录本可无创反映AD脑内转录失调，Bace1等AT显著升高，具血液标志物潜力。

mech.title: Design, synthesis and multitarget evaluation of cyclopropyl-appended thiohydantoin derivatives as dual cholinesterase and COX inhibitors with antioxidant activity: a combined experimental and computational study.
mech.zh: 环丙基硫代乙内酰脲S-烷基化衍生物可同时抑制胆碱酯酶与COX并具抗氧化活性，是多靶点抗阿尔茨海默病候选物。

mech.title: Chronic kidney disease and cognitive decline: choroid plexus remodeling, glymphatic dysfunction, and alzheimer biomarker interpretation.
mech.zh: 慢性肾病通过脉络丛重塑和类淋巴功能障碍驱动认知衰退，并干扰阿尔茨海默病生物标志物判读。

mech.title: Molecular programs in human locus coeruleus link APOE and neuromelanin to Alzheimer's vulnerability.
mech.zh: 人类蓝斑空间转录组揭示APOE与神经黑色素通路共同塑造阿尔茨海默病易感性。

mech.title: Expression differences and diagnostic efficacy of core plasma biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease, cerebral small vessel disease and healthy adults.
mech.zh: 血浆p-Tau217和GFAP在AD与CSVD及健康人间差异显著，对AD诊断及两者鉴别效能最优。

mech.title: An Integrated Analysis of Manganese Metabolism-Related Genes and Their Association With Biomarkers, Immune Infiltration, and Clinical Subtypes in Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 锰代谢相关基因可作阿尔茨海默病诊断标志物，并与免疫浸润及临床亚型相关。

mech.title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Exosomes for Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanisms, Preclinical Evidence, and Translational Challenges.
mech.zh: MSC外泌体可跨血脑屏障多靶点干预AD病理，但临床转化仍面临挑战。

mech.title: Novel Therapeutic Insights Into Alzheimer's Disease: Glymphatic System and Meningeal Lymphatic Vessels.
mech.zh: 综述提出靶向类淋巴系统和脑膜淋巴管清除Aβ与tau，或成AD新治疗方向。

dx.title: Chronic kidney disease and cognitive decline: choroid plexus remodeling, glymphatic dysfunction, and alzheimer biomarker interpretation.
dx.zh: 慢性肾病通过脉络丛重塑和类淋巴功能障碍等机制驱动认知衰退，并干扰阿尔茨海默病生物标志物解读。

dx.title: Expression differences and diagnostic efficacy of core plasma biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease, cerebral small vessel disease and healthy adults.
dx.zh: 血浆p-Tau217和GFAP在AD与CSVD及健康人间差异显著，对AD诊断及两者鉴别效能最优。

dx.title: Sociodemographic and clinical characteristics of participants in blood p-tau217 studies for Alzheimer's disease: A systematic review.
dx.zh: 血p-tau217诊断AD的研究人群多集中于记忆门诊和高度选择样本，社会人口学与临床特征报告不足，代表性存疑。

dx.title: Neuroimaging in the era of biologically defined Alzheimer's disease and disease-modifying therapy.
dx.zh: 生物标志物与淀粉样蛋白PET正重塑阿尔茨海默病的诊断、治疗准入及疗效监测路径。

dx.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
dx.zh: 基于Aβ42/40与p-tau217的专家混合模型血筛算法，可显著减少临床前AD试验中淀粉样蛋白PET筛查的不合格率。

dx.title: Alterations of gut microbiota in Down syndrome and their association with Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 唐氏综合征成人肠道菌群组成改变与阿尔茨海默病血浆标志物及认知衰退相关。

dx.title: Blood biomarkers of brain damage in Transient Ischemic Attack: the role of plasma NfL and GFAP.
dx.zh: 血浆NfL与GFAP可区分MRI阴性的TIA患者与健康人，提示TIA存在常规影像无法检出的神经元和胶质损伤。

dx.title: Are infraslow oscillations the missing link between sleep and Alzheimer's?
dx.zh: AD患者睡眠纺锤波超慢振荡峰值振幅降低，或为睡眠与阿尔茨海默病间的关键环节。

prev.title: Parental longevity and polygenic longevity scores in relation to ageing-related factors in a population of 70-year-olds followed over six years: The Gothenburg H70 Birth Cohort Study.
prev.zh: 父母长寿与多基因长寿评分仅与部分衰老指标相关，APOE位点显著影响其关联强度。

prev.title: Cadmium exposure and incidence of all-cause dementia and Alzheimer's disease in US adults.
prev.zh: 美国成人血镉和尿镉水平升高与全因痴呆及阿尔茨海默病发病风险显著正相关。

prev.title: Altered Epoxyeicosatrienoic Acid Signaling in Advanced-Stage Alzheimer's Disease (Investigation of Epoxyeicosatrienoic Acid Levels in Patients with Advanced Alzheimer's Disease).
prev.zh: 晚期迟发型阿尔茨海默病患者血浆四种EET异构体均显著低于健康对照，提示EET信号通路下调参与疾病进程。

prev.title: Phenomic profiles and disease patterns of 1.9 million participants from Our Future Health.
prev.zh: 英国百万人队列揭示疾病表型分布，但少数族裔与最贫困群体代表性不足。

prev.title: Multilingual lexical feature analysis of spoken language for predicting major depression symptom severity.
prev.zh: 多语言口语词汇特征可线性预测抑郁严重度，但高维嵌入未显著提升PHQ-8预测精度。

prev.title: Associations of cognitive reserve with IGF-1 and global cognition differ by early-life conditions and APOE genotype.
prev.zh: IGF-1与认知的关联因APOE基因型和早年环境而异，提示认知储备路径具基因-环境特异性。

prev.title: Mortality patterns related to stroke and dementia among older adults in the U. S.: a CDC WONDER analysis from 1999 to 2024.
prev.zh: 1999至2024年美国老年人卒中与痴呆相关死亡率总体上升，且存在显著人群与地区差异。

prev.title: Remote digital cognitive assessment in a trial-ready Alzheimer's disease cohort: A scalable approach for early intervention studies.
prev.zh: 高频远程智能手机认知测评在常染色体显性阿尔茨海默病队列中可行、可靠且有效，可扩展用于早期干预试验。

intro.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
intro.zh: 抽血查几个指标就能提前挑出大脑里可能已悄悄长斑块的老人，帮他们更快更省地参加防痴呆新药的试验。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆可能是一根藤上的两个瓜，控好血糖、护好大脑，或许能帮我们老得慢一点、糊涂得晚一点。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 治早期阿尔茨海默病的新药虽能清脑内淀粉样蛋白，却可能让脑血管变脆、引发脑水肿或微出血，这篇综述提醒普通人：有脑血管问题的人用前得格外小心。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 科学家用人的干细胞在培养皿里造出迷你大脑，专门研究大脑里的“保安细胞”怎么在老年痴呆中帮倒忙，帮我们找新药。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是抽血查阿尔茨海默病的新方法，比腰穿和脑扫描更便宜、少遭罪，有望让普通人早筛查早干预。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑里的“清道夫”细胞失灵后会怎样一步步把阿尔茨海默病推向恶化，并指出未来或许能靠修复它们来治病。

intro.title: Brain organoids in Alzheimer disease and related tauopathies: Challenges and opportunities for translational readiness.
intro.zh: 科学家正想办法用迷你人脑试药来替代不准的小鼠实验，好让阿尔茨海默病新药别再白忙一场。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期失眠可能悄悄增加痴呆风险，这篇综述讲怎么通过改善睡眠和大脑自身保护机制来帮女性防痴呆。
